tldr: Checkout was down 23 minutes; about 2,000 customers affected
Root cause: a config change set the payment timeout to zero
Timeout validation and a checklist update agreed

action_items.action: Add validation so the payment timeout can't be below one second
Update the change review checklist to include config values

details.impact: About two thousand customers couldn't pay for twenty-three minutes
details.root_cause: A config change set the payment timeout to zero

incident_timeline.event: Alert fired for checkout errors; on-call paged
